The remainder of the sprint (tests, a 1-line import merge in app.calculator.tsx, tests/README.md) is commit ffd3bf7, which is the commit this evidence is bound to; the tree at ffd3bf7 is the tree that was gated and MCP-validated. Consequence: the M4 application source is on origin/main under an RFC commit message, ahead of Code Review/QA and of this handoff; a human should decide whether that matters for review/audit-trail purposes.

tool_call_ref values are descriptive ids, not runtime tool_use ids: the Claude Code runtime does not expose the toolu_... block id to this agent, so each of the three validate_component_codeblocks calls is identified by a descriptive ref plus the real Dev MCP conversationId (8d89719e-2083-4756-bd6b-c5bd10ca0e8b). This is a consistency-checked record, not an authenticated capture of the live MCP call (the schema's own caveat).

The validator input was passed as the byte-copied content of each file after its final edit; validated_input_sha256 values are hashes of the files on disk at ffd3bf7 and no UI file was edited after validation. This agent cannot independently prove the MCP received exactly those bytes beyond that.

MCP scope limit: validate_component_codeblocks type-checks Polaris component names/props/slots only. It accepts s-button command/commandFor and s-modal slots as typed, but it cannot prove the runtime behaviour of the save-confirmation modal (show/hide, primary-action submit) or the App Bridge toast in a real embedded Admin iframe. app/components/expense-breakdown.tsx has no Polaris components, so its 'validation' is a no-op recorded for completeness.
run-gates.py cross-platform gap (see each gate's detail): gate logs are manual equivalents, not produced by run-gates.py.

Double-submit: the modal's Save button is disabled while the request is in flight (client-side), but there is no server-side idempotency key (no schema column for one; the schema is G-Schema-owned and was not touched). Two genuinely concurrent POSTs of the same payload would create two history rows. Append-only history has no dedupe by design; flagged, not fixed.

Engine-version drift policy (a judgement call): the server recomputes with the CURRENT engine at save time and stores that engine's ENGINE_VERSION. If the engine changed between Calculate and Save, the save is rejected only when the recomputed amounts differ from what the merchant saw (with a 'run Calculate again' message); if amounts are identical it saves under the current version. The payload's own claimed 'ev' is never persisted.
Timestamps are rendered in UTC with an explicit 'UTC' suffix (formatSavedAt) because the project timezone is still unconfirmed (spec OQ-6). No local-time conversion was invented.

Detail page '% of revenue' and the donut geometry are display-only math derived at render time from the STORED amounts (same as the mockup); the engine is never invoked on the detail path (static test + FT-14a). Engine version is shown as the stored string 'expense-engine@1.0.0' where the mockup showed '1.0.0'.

DB-backed tests (tests/db) are opt-in and NOT in the default `npm test` / CI run (no DATABASE_URL secret in CI, .github/workflows/app-ci.yml) -- they were run manually against the real Neon Postgres this sprint (22/22 passed; log committed). Until CI has a throwaway Postgres, FT-02b/FT-14 DB-level coverage depends on someone running them with RUN_DB_TESTS=1.

Sequelize behaviour observed live, not a defect: when the DEFERRED reconciliation trigger fails at COMMIT, Sequelize logs 'Committing transaction ... failed ... We are killing its connection' and discards that connection; with pool.max=1 the next query opens a fresh connection (proven by the 'pool not wedged' checks). It costs a reconnect on that rare path.

Pre-existing, NOT fixed (out of this sprint's scope, disclosed per instruction): (a) app.calculator.tsx's per-category at-a-glance summary and 'Fixed amount' prefix hardcode '$' regardless of the selected currency (CAD/EUR/GBP show '$'); (b) formatRuleApplied (moved unchanged from app.results.tsx) renders fixed amounts as '450.00 fixed' with no currency symbol; (c) db/config/config.cjs P3 (eager 3-env evaluation) untouched per instruction. None is a direct consequence of M4.

No migration was run or needed this sprint: the calculation / calculation_line_item tables, append-only trigger and reconciliation trigger were already applied on the target Neon database. Placeholder rates/formulas remain illustrative pending OQ-4.
Not touched, per instruction: db/config/config.cjs, shopify.app.toml, project.json, hosting/Vercel config.
